name: Obsidian-App
description: Obsidian is a powerful and extensible knowledge base that works on top of a local folder of plain text Markdown files. This version installs the application only; GUI access requires separate setup (e.g., X11 forwarding).

notes.text: This script installs the Obsidian application. Accessing its GUI requires manual setup (e.g., X11 forwarding from your desktop to the LXC).
Consider creating a `/vaults` directory in the LXC and mounting your Obsidian vaults there for data persistence. You can do this via Proxmox's LXC 'Resources' > 'Mount Point' settings.
